world_seed.visual_direction: Verdigris copper, salt-white stone, indigo water, coral-red seals

genre: tidal diplomatic habitat, sediment memory, ecological treaty economy
premise: An embassy built on shifting sands reconstructs the legal personhood of extinct rivers using sediment memories and hydrological testimony.
simulation_objective: Negotiate the restoration of the Aethel River while managing the rising tide and competing silt claims.
economy_focus: Trading flow rights, authenticated silt, and flood testimony.
exploration_focus: Uncovering submerged archives and tracing extinct watershed boundaries.
conflict_tone: Bureaucratic tension, environmental urgency, and historical erasure.
visual_style: Top-down pixel art with verdigris copper accents, salt-crusted stone, and deep indigo water.

social_rules: All silt trades must be witnessed by a Scribe and sealed with coral wax.
No freshwater may be used for cleaning; it is for drinking and memory-cultivation only.
During high tide, all legal proceedings are suspended and the Chamber is sealed.
The Tide Watcher's signal is absolute; failure to evacuate a flooded zone is a crime.
player_entry_points: Arriving as a junior delegate on the morning supply barge.
Waking up in the Salt Gardens after a shipwreck.
Being hired as a temporary guard during the Aethel hearings.
conflict_hooks: The Aethel's Heart Silt has been stolen from the Submerged Archive.
The tide is rising faster than predicted, threatening to drown the treaty before it is signed.
A Silt Broker is accused of selling 'Sea Sand' as authenticated river memory.
